model.name: 10Eros Max H3 hybrid beta5 INT8 (Ref2VA)
model.description: 10Eros-Max beta5 hybrid (non-Turbo) INT8 finetune for Reference-to-Video-and-Audio. Full-step model; no turbo LoRA is baked in.
model.infos:
## 10Eros Max H3 hybrid beta5 INT8 (non-Turbo)
The full-step counterpart of the TURBO-hybrid beta5 finetune. No turbo delta is baked in, so it needs more sampling steps and no turbo LoRA should be added.

Suggestion:
- Use the default full-step settings (Euler, ~20 steps) or increase steps for quality.
- Author notes that non-turbo full-step audio is better than the turbo versions.

Intended to work in both Ref2VA and FL2VA modes (also registered as a separate FL2VA finetune).
